title: Fleet decision file (harness-command contract)
description: How a harness command raises a human decision from inside the sandbox: write this file to the well-known path .fleet/out/decision.json and end the turn. The runner watches the path, wraps it into a `decision` event (adding job/seq/id), and blocks the job. This convention is CLI-independent — it is why the required event core survives vendor stream-format churn — and it ships as a rule in harness command templates. An agent may never resolve its own blocker: answers arrive only through the daemon.

note.description: Why the fleet cannot infer this — a policy call, not a data question.
